rule: For each patch and each of four discovery views (two prompts x mean real Question queries / P-1), count all 32 layers where head-mean visual-conditional probability >=5/576 AND patch is in top58 (stable index ties). A view is persistent at >=8 layers. Candidate requires >=3/4 persistent views. No ROI, labels, margins or depth-specific preference used. Holdout uses both Q/A views persistent at >=8 layers. Empty sets remain empty.
